Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREIn this bundleJust Dance: Decades of HitsView add-onJust Dance Free ExperienceView gameDescriptionIMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades. DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like: - "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny - "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter - "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar - "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon - "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz - "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC - "Wannabe" by Spice Girls - "No Scrubs" by TLC - "It's Tricky" by Run DMC - "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel - "Mamma Mia" by ABBA AND MORE! From easy-to-follow to satisfyingly challenging, this year's track list is made to get players of all ages and styles dancing together! DISCOVER A FUN ADVENTURE FOR ALL GENERATIONS Explore the decades together in the new Adventure Mode. Discover 6 themed worlds, dance to iconic songs, enjoy fun mini-activities, and unlock exclusive rewards. Only available with Just Dance: Decades of Hits! ENDLESS WAYS TO PARTY Dance with up to 6 players locally, jump into Party Mode or get moving with Workout Mode. Grab your friends and family, choose your mode or dance, and let the party begin! Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionIt's time to wield the beat in Alpha Nomos, a rhythm-action roguelite where every instrument is a weapon and every fight moves to the music. Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world where combat pulses to the soundtrack and timing is everything. Who knew saving the world could sound this good? Join Cello and her friends as they explore their ruined world, fight murderous puppets, and uncover the mysteries of the powerful force known as music. What caused the destruction of this world? What is music? What is Alpha Nomos? All these answers await Cello as she fights to bring balance back to a corrupted world. Time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos. Master the rhythm, gather living sound, and breathe life back into a world that moves to the music you make.
